skills.title: UA to GA4 Field Name Mapping
skills.description: Universal Analytics (UA) and GA4 use different names for equivalent concepts. UA was sunset on 2023-07-01; models trained before or around then guess UA field names that no longer exist in the GA4 Data API. On 2024-05-06 GA4 also renamed \"conversions\" to \"key events\" (see the conversions rows below). If a name feels obviously right but returns \"Invalid metric/dimension\", assume your training predates the change and verify with searchschema. This skill gives the correct GA4 Data API name for every common UA metric and dimension.
